name: web-search.research
purpose: Answer one question at one ladder rung (l0 raw hits, l1 cited synthesis, l2 fetch-and-read), reading the findings ledger first and marking strong stored hits used when asked.

effort.description: Ladder rung. l3 has no governed binding and is reported unavailable.

limit.description: Max stored hits and max live results (1..50).

top_n.description: l2 only: result pages fetched and read (1..10).

mark_used.description: Record `findings use` for every strong stored hit.

capture.description: l2 only: distill the synthesis into the findings store.

assumptions: web-search is running and its Connect-RPC bindings are reachable from the kernel
the caller treats status unavailable as unknown, never as no answer
effort l3 is started by hand with `web-search research l3 <query>`; the binding is run-ineligible
the `synthesis` keyword is the binding's argument name for the request field `synthesize`, as `bindings describe` reports it
invariants: the findings ledger is read before any live answer is trusted

the program writes through exactly two bindings: research l2 (only at effort l2, with capture as the caller set it) and findings use (only when mark_used is true and the hit is active, not weak, confidence >= 0.5 and at most 180 days old); both run in act, never in collect
research l2 is called with capture exactly as the caller set it; l0 and l1 never persist findings
no row set is materialized; stored hits are head(limit) with claims cut to 140 characters; the envelope fits the 4 KB stdout bound
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.answer_kind: one of stored_finding, cited_synthesis, raw_hits, none
signals.confidence: max stored-finding confidence when answer_kind is stored_finding; null otherwise
signals.citations: l1: synthesis citations; l2: {url, title} from the excerpts rows (the brief carries no citations); stored: {finding_id}
signals.stored_hits: At most ten stored hits with id, claim, status, confidence, score, weak, retrieval_date, age_days and usable (the skill's ledger-answers gate).
signals.strong_hit_count: count of non-weak, non-superseded stored hits
signals.live_result_count: count of live results (l0/l1) or excerpts (l2)
signals.cached: l0/l1: results came from the TTL cache
signals.degraded: l0/l1: the governor or upstream declined the call
signals.degraded_reason: l0/l1: the reason string when degraded
signals.abstained: l1/l2: the synthesis abstained because sources were thin or in conflict
signals.captured_finding_ids: l2 with capture: finding ids written
signals.marked_used: finding ids for which findings use was recorded
signals.live_rung: the live rung that ran, or null
